method.adoption_rule: registered overlap of at least 0.8 and a shift inside the 6.0 m search window; otherwise the prior polygon is kept
method.cross_check: NAIP NDWI (green and near infrared) water polygon above the Otsu threshold of the window, translated to the lidar frame by the best-overlap shift
method.outline: boundary of the airborne lidar return void (no class 2 or class 20 return in 0.5 m cells) containing the pool center, smoothed and simplified with a tolerance of 0.15 to 0.5 m scaled to pool area

pools.adoption_reason: imagery cross-check below threshold or shift at search limit; steam or wet surfaces make the return void unreliable
pools.name: Excelsior Geyser Crater
